title: Pelorus tester report, schema version 2
description: Written by tools/tester/pelorus_tester_report.py (ADR-0173). The program checks it with the keyword subset type, const, enum, pattern, maxLength, minimum, minItems, required, properties, additionalProperties and items.

schema_version.description: Bumped when a field is removed or changes meaning; an added field stays in the same version only if optional with a default. Version 2 added execution_class, evidence_claim, stage status pass_software and tool.sha256.

sha256.description: Digest of the tester program files that produced the report (tool_digest in pelorus_tester_report.py); report intake checks it against tools/tester/tool-hashes.json.

commit.description: Source commit of the kit; 'unknown' only for a run outside a published package.

kit.description: Optional, added in tool 0.4.0 (absent means source). The tester image kit that ran (PELORUS_TESTER_KIT, ADR-0180), or source for a run from a checkout. intel-nonfree-local: a local build with the non-free Intel media driver (its image carries the NOT-FOR-REDISTRIBUTION marker and is never published). A vendor kit's no_device reasons name its docker option (--gpus all, --device /dev/dri).

execution_class.description: Derived from devices[]: hardware when a device is not PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_CPU, software_vulkan when every device is CPU type (lavapipe, SwiftShader), no_vulkan when there is none. The validator re-derives it.

evidence_claim.description: gpu only when execution_class is hardware; a software or absent device can claim functional evidence only.

status.description: pass_software: a needs_device stage that passed on software Vulkan; functional evidence only, never a GPU claim.

legs.description: Optional, added in tool 0.4.0: one entry per encoder the stage tried (steering_smoke, sidedata_roundtrip). A stage cannot pass with a failed leg or without a passing one; a leg that is not pass carries a reason.
